trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

1. **Problem:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, was failing health checks, and had an 18% error rate. Its test build (v2.3.1-rc) had also been failing in staging.
2. **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. After the rollback the service reports healthy, with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Incident:** I opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api), which paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure and the rollback, and suggests two next steps: find what's wrong in v2.3.1 before redeploying it, and work out why it went to production when its staging version was failing.
   - The first attempt to create the incident timed out. No incident appeared afterwards, so I sent the same request again with the same key, which prevents duplicates. I then checked that there is only one incident, INC-0001.
